data.content_ref: inline:The isolated block integrates SRC_002's algebraic CRT lattice derivation with SRC_005's exhaustive minimality verification, yielding a dual-proof framework where the algebraic method generates the candidate 18 and the enumeration method confirms no smaller positive integer works. It is refuted if either proof method independently yields a different smallest solution, or if the two methods disagree on the residue class membership of 18.
